basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Reviews packages of metadata projections for joint disclosure risk, not single fields in isolation.
Checks that a review still applies under the current context and returns stale when inputs changed.
No review status is a grant: serving data needs a separate current authorization.

may: Validate the member grammar and pins of a disclosure package.
Record a concern about side channels and keep reports internal.
Return stale or insufficient-context when the current context differs.
mustNot: Treat a positive review as permission to disclose.
Downgrade an opaque pin to make a review pass.
Reuse a review for a different revision or digest.
requiresHuman: Assessing rejected, inconclusive or conflicting reviews.
Deciding to disclose a package that combines sensitive fields.

considerations: Combining harmless fields can re-identify people; joint review exists to prevent that.
Review reports themselves may reveal sensitive structure and must stay internal.
Over-disclosure harms people irreversibly; when in doubt the review must not pass.
affectedParties: People whose data could be re-identified
Recipients who rely on disclosed data

owners.steward: The information governance or privacy office stewards disclosure reviews; each data domain owns its own fields.

items: Package ID with exact member pins.
Review ID bound to the package revision and digest.

properties.reason: Institutional or informational subject: it has no physical body to measure.

items: A disclosure review covers a named package of metadata projections and an attributed verdict.
Stale approval reused after the data changed.
Applies before company data is released inside or outside the organization.

sections.whatItIs: A companion contract for a Company Dimension that describes exact packages of metadata projections proposed for disclosure and keeps attributed reviews of what their joint release could reveal, checked against the current context.

sources.title: Research record EM-XCT-05: independent provider studies, audits and reconciled findings
sources.note: Evidence behind the release; claims in the card trace to it.
